description: Quote the exact Gold price to create music, optionally with lyrics. Returns gold_cost and quote_token without starting a job or charging Gold. After the user approves, call chargen_generate_music with the same inputs and quote_token.

duration_seconds.description: Audio duration in seconds, where supported.

instrumental.description: Create music without vocals, where supported.

lyrics.description: Lyrics for a model that supports singing.

model.description: Enabled audio model supporting music; chargen_list_media_models can help choose a model. This never changes the operation.

negative_prompt.description: Things to keep out of the result, as a short list. Only some models take one: chargen_list_media_models shows negative_prompt in that model's settings, and any other model refuses this argument.

prompt.description: The musical style: genre, mood, instruments, pace. Words to sing go in lyrics. chargen_list_media_models with this mode says how to phrase it for each model (prompt_styles); nothing improves the wording on the way to the model.

name: chargen_quote_music
title: Quote music
